title: The Valuable advice of the lawyer
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：valuable　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 valuable 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the driver wrote of ① a valuable advice of the lawyer in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② more valuable than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the valuable ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most valuable advice of the lawyer anybody in the station had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1960 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too valuable to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the valuable ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a valuable stone in the ring, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as valuable as the stone in the ring they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was valuable or not, and he said so.

By 1973 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something valuable, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite valuable; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the valuable ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1976, without complaint, she wrote of another valuable advice of the lawyer in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ more valuable than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most valuable stone in the ring in the whole station, she said in 1978, was the one she could never quite name; the valuable ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有价值（前置定语 a valuable advice of the lawyer：1966 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件有价值的建议）
B. adj. 有价值／贵重（比较级 more valuable than：文中两处，一处比律师有价值的建议，一处比预想）
C. adj. 有价值／贵重（最高级 the most valuable：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有价值（表语 too valuable to do：母亲觉得它太有价值，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 贵重（前置定语 a valuable stone in the ring：叔叔把整件事称作一桩贵重的宝石）
F. adj. 贵重（同级比较 as valuable as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩戒指上贵重的宝石相比）
G. adj. 贵重（后置定语 something valuable：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 贵重（受程度副词修饰 quite valuable：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: a valuable advice of the lawyer
the most valuable advice of the lawyer anybody
a valuable stone in the ring
The most valuable stone in the ring in

answers.why: valuable 意为“有价值”，1966 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件有价值的建议”，此处作前置定语 a valuable advice of the lawyer。
valuable 意为“有价值”，此处用比较级 more valuable than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
valuable 意为“有价值”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说它是车站里最有价值的一件，故用最高级 the most valuable advice of the lawyer。
valuable 意为“有价值”，母亲认为这件东西“太有价值了，谁也用不上”，too valuable to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
valuable 意为“贵重”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩贵重的宝石”，此处作前置定语 a valuable stone in the ring。
valuable 意为“贵重”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩戒指上贵重的宝石一样贵重”，同级比较用 as valuable as。
valuable 意为“贵重”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“贵重的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something valuable。
valuable 意为“贵重”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当贵重”，quite 修饰原级 valuable。
valuable 意为“贵重”，1976 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要贵重”，故用比较级 more valuable than。
valuable 意为“贵重”，母亲 1978 年说的是“整个车站里最贵重的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most valuable stone in the ring。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件有价值的建议。（a valuable advice of the lawyer）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更有价值。（more valuable than …）
母亲觉得它太有价值，谁也用不上。（too valuable to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩贵重的宝石。（a valuable stone in the ring）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩戒指上贵重的宝石一样贵重。（as valuable as …）
到了 1973 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件贵重的东西。（something valuable）
answers: In 1966 the driver wrote of a valuable advice of the lawyer in the timetable.
Everybody said it was more valuable than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too valuable to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a valuable stone in the ring.
He said nobody would call it as valuable as the stone in the ring they had once had.
By 1973 the timetable asked for nothing but something valuable.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 valuable 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the driver wrote of a valuable advice of the lawyer in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most valuable advice of the lawyer in the station, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too valuable to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a valuable stone in the ring, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite valuable, and everybody laughed.
The valuable ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
